# pangolin_ai_models (Data Source)

Lists the model entries (allow or block rules for one upstream model key) of an AI provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_ai_models" "gpt" {
  provider_id = pangolin_ai_provider.openai.id
  query       = "gpt"
}

output "gpt_model_keys" {
  value = [for m in data.pangolin_ai_models.gpt.models : m.model_key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the AI provider.

### Optional

- `query` (String) Only return models whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) List of model entries, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The numeric model ID.
- `list_type` (String) Whether the entry allows or blocks the model.
- `model_key` (String) The upstream model key.
- `name` (String) The display name.
